description: This PHP class 'Task' manages scheduled tasks within the Opencart administrative system, providing methods to add, update, delete, and retrieve task records from the database, including logging capabilities.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing scheduled tasks within the Opencart admin system, including CRUD operations and logging.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database, deleting any existing task with the same code beforehand.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and response of a specific task identified by task ID, ensuring the status is within allowed values.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a task record from the database by task ID.

methods.name: deleteTaskByCode
methods.description: Deletes task(s) from the database based on the task code.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empties the entire task table, removing all task records.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Fetches a specific task record from the database by task ID.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves multiple task records, optionally filtered by code and status, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Returns the total count of task records, optionally filtered.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Inserts a log entry associated with a task code, including a comment and status.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of task log entries with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Counts the total number of task log entries.
